## <a name="page_4" class="page-number">4.0</a> Outpost General Questions

**What buildings are available at the start?** The Barracks and Workshop are available.

**What can I build at the start of the game?**
- Build a Logging Camp.
- Build Wall Section J.
- Build any of the three Travel Tools.
